title: JazzCash success story (English rebuild reference)
summary: A 90 s vertical success-story explainer from the same channel, in the storybook look but driven by cuts and match-cuts rather than one continuous camera. The hero object is a paper plane (money moving). Business mechanics become objects: nesting dolls for a rename, joining coin halves for a partnership, a snakes-and-ladders board for the slow old process, an umbrella for the parent brand, gears for services, scratch card and lock screen for years. Arc: today's scale, 'did you know it began as...', origin year and partners, the problem, the solution, features, rebrand, growth milestones, today.

narration.script: Today, millions of people in Pakistan use JazzCash to send money, pay bills and make online payments. But did you know it started out as a service called Mobicash? The story began in 2012, when Mobilink teamed up with Waseela Microfinance Bank to launch Mobicash. Back then, to send money or pay a bill, you often had to go to a bank, where even a small task took a lot of time. Mobicash made this easy. People could send money, receive it, and pay utility bills through their nearby shopkeeper. They could also send money and do other financial tasks from their mobile phone. At first, the service went by Mobilink's name. But in 2016, Mobilink introduced its new identity, Jazz, so Mobicash became JazzCash. After that, JazzCash kept improving its mobile app, online payments and business services. In 2020, it also launched a separate app for businesses, so shopkeepers could accept digital payments. Today, JazzCash isn't just a way to send money; it's one of Pakistan's biggest digital financial platforms.
narration.voice: Single male narrator, clear, upbeat and informative; even pace.
